name: How to Compare Garage Addition Contractor Bids

mainEntity.name: How do I compare garage addition contractor bids in Los Angeles County without getting fooled by a low price?
mainEntity.text: How do I compare garage addition contractor bids in Los Angeles County without getting fooled by a low price?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest mistake homeowners make is comparing garage addition quotes by total number only. A low bid can look attractive until the contractor adds exclusions or change orders for items that should have been included from the start. Good bids should spell out the scope, material allowances, permit handling, inspections, demolition if needed, utility work, and what is not included. In Los Angeles County, where permitting and site conditions can be complex, homeowners should also check whether the contractor has accounted for engineering, drainage, and any city-specific requirements. It helps to ask each bidder the same set of questions and request a written breakdown of assumptions. If one bid is much lower than the others, that often means something was missed rather than a true bargain. The safest choice is usually the contractor who explains the work clearly and prices it transparently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare bids by scope, not just total price. A fair garage addition bid should clearly list foundation, framing, roofing, electrical, finishes, permits, and exclusions. The cheapest bid may leave out engineering, site work, permit fees, or upgrades that become expensive later.
